message.content: In one of the messages, WolfgangSchulz informs LiHua that he is almost done with the new software he's been working on. Wolfgang expresses excitement about LiHua being among the first users and mentions that LiHua will likely enjoy the features. This indicates a positive reaction from LiHua, who responds with enthusiasm, expressing her eagerness to try the software and noting that she believes it will make her work easier. LiHua's comments demonstrate her anticipation and interest in using the new software, suggesting that she is pleased with the progress and looks forward to its release.
